content.text:
Everything is clean. Here is a summary of every change made.

---

## What was built

### Files created

**`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/app-embed.liquid`**

The new App Embed block. When a merchant enables it from Theme Editor > App Embeds, it injects `window.__zccAppEnabled = true` into the page `<body>`. This is the master on/off toggle for the entire app in a given theme.

---

### Files modified

**`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/extensions/zip-code-widget/shopify.extension.toml`**

Added a third `[[extensions.blocks]]` entry registering the `app_embed` block type with `target = "body"`. Shopify reads this to surface the toggle in Theme Editor > App Embeds.

**`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid`**

Added an early-return guard at the top of the IIFE:
```javascript
if (!window.__zccAppEnabled) return;
```
If the merchant has not enabled the App Embed, the widget script exits immediately without rendering anything.

**`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.widget.tsx`**

Three changes:

1. **Imports** — added `Badge` from Polaris and `ExternalIcon` from `@shopify/polaris-icons`.

2. **Loader** — now calls `admin.graphql` to query `themes(roles: [MAIN])`, extracts the active theme's numeric ID from its GID, then returns `activeThemeName`, `themeEditorUrl` (pointing to the specific theme ID), and `themeEditorAppEmbedsUrl` (same URL with `?context=apps` to open the App Embeds tab directly). The GraphQL call is wrapped in try/catch — if it fails, both URLs fall back to `/admin/themes/current/editor`.

3. **Setup card UI** — replaced the vague "Add widget to your storefront" card with an **App Embed Status** card that:
   - Shows the active theme name from the loader
   - Has a `Badge tone="warning"` reading "Setup Required"
   - Lists the three steps (enable App Embed, add widget block, save)
   - Provides "Enable in Theme Editor" (primary, opens App Embeds tab) and "Add Widget Block" (opens product template), both with `ExternalIcon` and `target="_blank"`
   - Includes an info `Banner` with instructions
   - All three action buttons call `markSetupDone` on click so the card collapses into the success banner after the merchant acts
